# Preserve secondary sort when leaving grouped sorting

At revision 15d5d77155114f0148eaf19c0b958ffd8be51647, the about3Pane grouped-sort exit path sets the new primary sort and carries the current primary sort into the secondary slot before ending the batched view update. Its source comment explains that dbView otherwise retains the secondary sort from before grouping and can reuse it when opening the new view. Preserve this explicit sort-state setup when changing this path. This is scoped source evidence, not runtime validation or a rule for all sorting implementations.

Scope: message view sorting.
